newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Golden Vale liqueur unit to invest 6.2mln st.
newsitem.headline: Golden Vale liqueur unit to invest 6.2mln st.

text.p: Golden Vale Plc said on Thursday that its cream liqueur business plans to invest 6.2 million sterling over the next five years to expand its export sales and product development.

Northern Ireland-based Saint Brendan's Irish Cream Liqueur Company will receive 1.5 million sterling toward the cost of the investment from Northern Ireland's Industrial Development Board (IDB), Golden Vale said in a statement.
The investment should result in a doubling of the numbers employed by the company to 105 from the current level of 52.

"In addition to expenditure on new plant and machinery to increase efficiency, the project involves a significant increase in spending to support our brands and expand market share world-wide," Liam Mackessy, Golden Vale's director with responsibility for the cream liqueur business, said.
"New product development is also being expanded as part of our overall business strategy to strengthen the company's base by developing and diversifying our product portfolio," he said.
Saint Brendan's, which was acquired by Golden Vale in 1993, currently exports to over 35 countries.
